text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still need to lock owners and deadlines for the cloud auth + model-registry outage mitigations. Can we confirm who owns what?

sam: I can own the vendor SLA verification and contact list. Will ping account team for up-to-date escalation contacts. ETA EOD Thu. :thumbsup:

lee: I'll take the model-registry fallback plan (warm cold-cache fallback + read-only degraded mode). Need a review from infra before we finalize. Target next Tue for a draft runbook.

olivia: I'll do the auth provider hardening work (rotate keys, add health-checks, and add token-caching fallback). Propose a 2-week timeline for rollout to prod.

harry: I'll add a periodic incident hunting job to detect the recurrence pattern we saw (spikes in auth latencies -> model fetch timeouts). Will attach metric alerts to the new rule.

maya: Thanks all. Can we get tickets created and a tracking board? Prefer a single epic so we can report progress in the next weekly ops sync.

incident-bot: Created checklist: https://ourtracker.local/epics/INF-4021 "Cloud auth & model-registry resilience". Tasks created: INF-4022..INF-4026.

sam: Added vendor contact card to the epic and flagged the account team. Also requested a vendor post-incident remediation plan (timeline, root cause steps).

lee: Quick note — for the fallback we should validate KV cache TTLs. If we set aggressive TTLs the risk is stale responses; will add simulation in staging.

olivia: Agreed. I'll coordinate with Product on acceptable staleness levels and create a small eval suite.

harry: For recurrence detection, I'll add a weekly digest to #incidents with a rolling 90-day view so folks can spot patterns before they become critical.

eng-oncall: Please add a canary for auth-provider failover in the oncall runbook. Also add an explicit rollback path if we enable degraded read-only mode for registry.

maya: Action items summary (from this thread):
- sam: vendor SLA & contacts (INF-4022) — EOD Thu
- lee: model-registry fallback runbook + staging sim (INF-4023) — next Tue
- olivia: auth hardening + eval suite (INF-4024) — 2w
- harry: recurrence detection + weekly digest (INF-4025) — 1w
- eng-oncall: canary + rollback steps (INF-4026) — 3 days

Please update the epic with progress and mark blockers. We'll review in ops sync on Friday. :eyes: 

sam: I also recommend we request a contractual uptime review from vendor legal for critical auth endpoints. I'll start that thread with Legal after the vendor response.

maya: Great — if no objections I'll close out actions here and move updates to the epic. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
